dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ploy, who are you going to talk about in class?
dialogue.reading: ˈplɔɪ, ˈhuː ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ɪn ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Joy Sriwan, the singer. She's had an amazing life.
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒɔɪ ˈsriːwɑːn, ðə ˈsɪŋər. ʃiːz ˈhæd ən əˈmeɪzɪŋ ˈlaɪf.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? I only know her songs. What was her life like before becoming famous?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈnoʊ hɜːr ˈsɔːŋz. ˈwʌt wʌz hɜːr ˈlaɪf laɪk bɪˈfɔːr bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ˈfeɪməs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: She grew up in poverty in a village in Isan. Her family struggled to buy food.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈɡruː ˈʌp ɪn ˈpɑːvərti ɪn ə ˈvɪlɪdʒ ɪn iˈsɑːn. hɜːr ˈfæməli ˈstrʌɡəld tə ˈbaɪ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible. How did she become a singer?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl. ˈhaʊ dɪd ʃiː bɪˈkʌm ə ˈsɪŋər?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: After leaving school at fifteen, she moved to Bangkok and worked in a restaurant.
dialogue.reading: ˈæftər ˈliːvɪŋ ˈskuːl ət ˌfɪfˈtiːn, ʃiː ˈmuːvd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk ənd ˈwɜːrkt ɪn ə ˈrɛstərɑːnt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It was. But she was determined to sing, so she sang in a talent show on TV.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈwʌz. bʌt ʃiː wʌz dɪˈtɜːrmɪnd tə ˈsɪŋ, soʊ ʃiː ˈsæŋ ɪn ə ˈtælənt ˌʃoʊ ɑːn ˌtiːˈviː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes! After winning, she recorded her first album. Ten years later, she started a business.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈæftər ˈwɪnɪŋ, ʃiː rɪˈkɔːrdɪd hɜːr ˈfɜːrst ˈælbəm. ˈtɛn ˈjɪrz ˈleɪtər, ʃiː ˈstɑːrtɪd ə ˈbɪznəs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A music school for poor children. Before opening it, she visited a hundred villages to find students!
dialogue.reading: ə ˈmjuːzɪk ˈskuːl fər ˈpʊr ˈtʃɪldrən. bɪˈfɔːr ˈoʊpənɪŋ ɪt, ʃiː ˈvɪzɪtɪd ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈvɪlɪdʒɪz tə ˈfaɪnd ˈstuːdənts!
